milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The bell is at spawn-relative (0, 4, 5) on the ceiling. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to confirm visual identification. Max distance of 8 allows the player to be standing beneath or near the bell (which is 4 blocks above floor level), and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures they are looking in the bell's direction.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The enchanting table is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 8) surrounded by bookshelves. The player must navigate close to it and face toward it. Max distance of 6 ensures the player is within the bookshelf enclosure area, and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees confirms they are looking at the table.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The granite stairs span spawn-relative X=[5-8], Z=[10-11], so the center target is approximately (6, 0, 10). The player must navigate to the right side of the room and face toward the stairs. Max distance of 8 gives adequate approach range, and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is oriented toward the stairs structure.
